findings: Both frozen backends have identical cumulative/last-threshold implementation, a common environment and explicit --spec-min-p 0.5.
Cumulative threshold is unset and defaults to zero; last threshold is unset and inherits the request step threshold.
STRATA_MTP_LAST_DRAFT_MIN_P=0.6 is a stale configuration key absent from both frozen executable strings and policy sources. It does not set the effective last threshold.
All 90 requests have the same output length/draft totals; all 45 instrumented requests have 20 windows and average T=3.85.
This audit does not compare separately running cumulative-threshold candidates or claim new throughput.
